title: Dinosaurs Are Still Here
paragraphs: Many people think dinosaurs disappeared a very long time ago. In fact, one group of dinosaurs is still alive today. You can see them in your garden, in the park and on the roof of your house. They are birds.

Scientists studied fossils and found that birds are close relatives of small, meat-eating dinosaurs. These animals walked on two legs, and many of them had feathers. The first feathered dinosaurs were found in China more than thirty years ago. Since then, scientists have found dozens more.

Scientists are still not sure why feathers first appeared. Some think that feathers kept the animals warm, and others think they helped animals to attract partners. The change from running dinosaurs to flying birds probably began about one hundred and sixty million years ago. So the next time you see a bird, remember that it is a living dinosaur.
